What we do
ValiRx Animal Health develops
i
nnovative veterinary oncology therapeutics
for companion animals. We apply
advanced biological science
and
translational research
to deliver scientifically validated, accessible
pet cancer care solutions
for veterinary medicine, thereby supporting companion animal health.
Our foundation
Built on ValiRx plc’s life sciences heritage, we combine scientific, technological and commercial expertise to bridge discovery and
deliver clinical impact
. Using translational models, we accelerate clinical relevant therapy development while
reducing risk
and
improving outcomes
.
Our approach
Working through
strategic partnerships
and
licensing collaborations
, we are building a robust veterinary oncology pipeline designed to deliver better outcomes for companion animals and create
value for partners
across the veterinary health sector.

Happy International Dog Day! While comparative oncology is about cutting-edge science, it's also important for pets and people to benefit from the same breakthroughs. At ValiRx Animal Health, Osteosarcoma is one of our key areas of interest because of the remarkable similarities between the disease in dogs and humans.

July is Sarcoma Awareness Month in the UK, one we take seriously at ValiRx Animal Health and ValiRx. Sarcoma is a rare cancer of the body's connective tissue; bone, muscle, fat, blood vessels, tendons, cartilage. It can arise almost anywhere, across dozens of subtypes that behave very differently. That diversity is exactly what makes it so hard to diagnose and treat.
